attchmntText: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release by the Company titled "Indian Terrain Fashions Limited announces Q2 FY27 Results"".
voiceSummary: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations for Q2 FY 2026-27 was Rs. 106.59 Crore, up 5.6% year-on-year. Half-year revenue grew 11.0% to Rs. 188.33 Crore. Gross margin expanded to 40.8% in Q2 and 40.9% in H1. Operating EBITDA rose 12.6% in Q2 to Rs. 9.58 Crore and 64.5% in H1 to Rs. 15.66 Crore. The company reported a positive Profit Before Tax of Rs. 2.93 Crore in Q2 and Rs. 3.07 Crore in H1. Profit After Tax stood at Rs. 5.09 Crore for Q2 and Rs. 4.26 Crore for H1. The exclusive retail network comprised 172 stores as of 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 106.59 Cr, a 5.6% year-on-year increase. Gross margin stood at 40.8%. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 9.58 Cr with a 9.0% margin. Profit before tax was Rs. 2.92 Cr, compared to Rs. 1.15 Cr in the prior year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue was Rs. 188.33 Cr, an 11.0% increase. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 15.66 Cr. Profit before tax was Rs. 3.06 Cr, marking a turnaround from a loss of Rs. 4.89 Cr in the previous half year. The company reported gross working capital improved by 26 days year on year to 300 days.

attchmntText: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indian Terrain Fashions Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board also approved a change in the Corporate Office address to Olympia Crest, 6th Floor, Plot No. 73, Electrical and Electronics Industrial Estate, Rajiv Gandhi Salai, Zone 1, Perungudi, Chennai – 600096, Tamil Nadu. The Registered Office remains unchanged. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 106.59 crore, compared to Rs. 100.96 crore in the same period last year. Net profit for the quarter was Rs. 5.09 crore, versus a net loss of Rs. 0.38 crore in the previous year. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 1.00. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 188.33 crore, with a net profit of Rs. 4.26 crore. Total assets as at 30th September 2026 were Rs. 444.35 crore.
